name: Instrument: Build the failure-mode evidence line (gated on `86ajgn2z5`)
text_content:
I1. The seven-field line, the unit of every diagnostic read and the answer to carryover 86akh67wy: mode, object among the five kinds, an openable signal source, a count in services or reviews or check-ins or captures or weeks, compensation by seat or designation or mechanism, the record's fix and the mechanism it touches, and state (present, not present, cannot read yet with reason). The same line at the leads' review, the house review, and the reset; the reason field of any change it produces, verbatim. Refuses a person's name, a verdict or rating or dimension, a figure in money or a percentage, a mode with no source, a sixth mode, and a kitchen line before the chef seat fills it. Lives on the leads' review record and the house memo on the team home, on whatever holds the hub role (86akh5u6e). Domain leads write, the Operations Lead writes the system side, the center integrates. High. Gated on 86ajgn2z5.

Filed by Session 9 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmj07. Reasoning lives on the S9 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

comment.text: Session 12 adds a failure-type field to the process update on the close record: basic, complex, or intelligent, set by the reviewing lead at every capture review, on the process update and not on the capture, with the reviewing lead's seat as the fix's owner and the count by type per period to item 1 of the leads' review. A capture that names a person as cause is re-written as process before it is typed; the capture's words are never edited; a count by person is never read; the non-negotiable breach is never typed. The evidence line reads the type's counts as it reads the capture rate and adds no person. S12 page, section 8; P28; instrument I4; readiness row 145.
